summary: This is a code-behind and ASP.NET markup for a 'Welcome Staff Admin' page showing user login info, error/warning panels, and a grid/list filter interface for employment applications with filtering, validation, and paging.
purpose: To present and filter student employment applications data to admin users, with facilities for showing/hiding errors and warnings, date range filtering, discipline and site selection, and basic input validation.

workflows.name: Viewing and Filtering Employment Applications
steps: Page loads and initializes controls, sets default date filters (-3 months to today).
User selects site and discipline from dropdowns (with 'All' option).
User sets start and end dates using text fields and calendar controls.
User can show/hide withdrawn applications via checkbox.
User clicks refresh, grid is updated.
Validations ensure date format and start <= end.
On row data bound, sets up hyperlinks for names and email, status displays based on withdrawn date.
Paging and error/warning summaries are available.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are shown or hidden based on checkbox.
Start date must not be after end date.
validations: CustomValidator for start date before end date.
conditions: Withdrawn applications set status and withdrawn date display.
Show/hide panels for errors or warnings.
system_behavior: Grid auto-binds on refresh or filter change.
Panel and field visibility based on state and errors.
JavaScript sets up date variables and client-side interaction.
content_gaps: No explicit user/system exceptions handled beyond display panels.
No business logic for application approval/rejection, only filtering and display workflow.
